purpose: Teach: マウンテン/ロハス/ベア/アルト/デュオ/ゴースト/オーソドックス/スピリット

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがマウンテンの登山を楽しまれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he loved mountain climbing.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze inward. Opening word gentle and warm. Slow, measured pace, as if retrieving something precious from memory. Trailing off slightly at the end, letting the image linger.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ロハスな農作業を続けて来られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you kept up that same simple, honest way of living all these years, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm and knowing, like she's gently correcting the record. Steady rhythm, affectionate on the final address. A light touch of teasing kindness underneath. Not asking, confirming.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが私にテディベアを下さった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he gave me a teddy bear.
lines.style: Quieter this time, more intimate. Delicate, as if the bear itself is still precious. Voice softens further. Held pause before speaking, like he's touching something fragile in his own chest.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、合唱団でアルトの方々と歌われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You sang alto in the choir, remember? You had such a beautiful voice, darling.
lines.style: Gently insistent, almost playful in her correction. She's redirecting him with warmth, not complaint. Alive with affection. Quick, sure rhythm until the final address, which lands soft.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが私と歌のデュオを組まれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he and I performed as a singing duo.
lines.style: Voice grows slightly stronger, more present. Pride in the memory, but still wistful. Deliberate pacing, giving each word room. The 'singing duo' hangs in the air like a duet itself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、映画でゴースト役を演じる夢を語られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You dreamed of playing a ghost in a film someday, didn't you? I remember you telling me.
lines.style: Amused and tender. She's caught him, gently. Lightness in her voice, the kind that says 'I see you.' Rhythm picks up slightly, like she's delighted by the memory. Settles warm on the final clause.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはオーソドックスな仕事の進め方を貫かれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he held to the most honest way of doing things.
lines.style: Reverent, almost. Slow and deliberate, each phrase carrying weight. Deep breath underneath the words. Comes to rest at the end like a lamp being set down carefully. Not wistful here — admiring.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、家族のスピリットを何より大事にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And above all else, you treasured your family, didn't you? That was always your greatest strength.
lines.style: Firm and full-hearted. She's naming something true and central. Voice steady and clear, no doubt in it. Closes with deep affection, like she's summing up a life. Warm and final.
